description: Player experience evaluation metrics for Sokoban puzzle maps.

experience_metrics.description: These items use a 5-point Likert scale (1: Strongly Disagree ~ 5: Strongly Agree)

metrics.name: enjoyment
metrics.description: Measures the overall enjoyment and satisfaction of engaging with the puzzle.

metrics.name: difficulty
metrics.description: Measures puzzle complexity, planning depth, and perceived challenge.

metrics.name: frustration
metrics.survey_item: I felt frustrated while solving it.
metrics.description: Captures negative emotions, dead ends, and feelings of unfairness or repetition.

metrics.name: novelty
metrics.survey_item: It had surprising or clever puzzle ideas.
metrics.description: Evaluates novelty, clever interactions, and unexpected puzzle structure.

metrics.name: aesthetics
metrics.survey_item: The puzzle layout felt elegant and well-designed.
metrics.description: Assesses the clarity, compactness, and visual/puzzle harmony of the level layout.

perception_metrics.description: Measures the player's perception of the creator before rating the experience.

metrics.name: creator_belief
metrics.survey_item: Who do you think designed this puzzle?

metrics.name: confidence_level
metrics.survey_item: How confident are you in your answer?

qualitative_reasoning.description: Open-ended question to understand the reasoning behind the numerical data.

metrics.name: reasoning_for_creator_belief
metrics.survey_item: What specific elements of the puzzle led you to believe it was [AI-generated / Human-designed]?

human_like_cues: A single elegant solution path with a clear 'aha' moment
Tight walls that eliminate trivial pushes
Goals and boxes arranged to force planning
ai_like_cues: Boxes or goals placed with no interaction
Dead-space walls serving no puzzle purpose
